<?php
class QuietWeakReferenceCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held, $target; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $target = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietWeakReferenceCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$target = new stdClass();
$held = WeakReference::create($target);
$wrapperWeak = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietWeakReferenceCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietWeakReferenceCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === $wrapperWeak->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_WRAPPER;";
echo $answer->get() === null ? "DEAD_TARGET;" : "BAD_TARGET;";
echo $held === null && $target === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $wrapperWeak->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietWeakReferenceAssignGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietWeakReferenceAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$target = new stdClass();
$held = WeakReference::create($target);
$wrapperWeak = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietWeakReferenceAssignGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietWeakReferenceAssignRight();
echo $answer === $wrapperWeak->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_WRAPPER;";
echo $answer->get() === $target ? "LIVE_TARGET;" : "BAD_TARGET;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $wrapperWeak->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$again = WeakReference::create($target);
echo $again->get() === $target && $wrapperWeak->get() === null ? "FRESH;" : "BAD_FRESH;";
unset($again);
$target = null;
echo "DONE;";
